title: Platen sensor open
fullDescription: APW Wyott clamshell/M-Series detected open temperature probe on the platen. Heat disabled.

faq.a: Each platen has its own probe.

title: Over temperature
fullDescription: Over-temp protection tripped. Stuck SSR or runaway sensor.

title: Heat-up timeout
shortDescription: Platen did not reach setpoint in time.
fullDescription: Element not delivering full power. Possible failed element or SSR.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Tech tests element resistance and replaces.

title: Communication error
shortDescription: Display lost link to control board.
fullDescription: Bus error. Reseat or replace boards.

title: Lid position fault
fullDescription: Clamshell up/down sensor reading invalid. Check magnet and switch.

faq.a: Use manual time only until repaired.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: DC fan in electronics bay not running.

faq.a: Save profiles via menu where supported.

title: Internal fault
fullDescription: Catch-all internal error. Power cycle, then service if persistent.

faq.a: Note frequency to help tech diagnose.
